fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/sugarloaf-i-campground ('Single Site: $24 per night'; 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night'); https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/232177 notice ('Site fee includes one RV with tow vehicle ... discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/sugarloaf-i-campground ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: On Zealand Road off US-302 near Twin Mountain, a short walk from the Zealand River and the Zealand Valley trailheads. Mostly tent sites: of the 17 that can be reserved, only 005, 011 and 016 take an RV (up to 35 ft); the 12 first-come sites are not described. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov confirm 29 sites, $24 (+$6 extra vehicle over RV+tow), vault toilets, hand-pump water, no dump, some sites reservable on rec.gov (17) and the rest first-come, mid-May to mid-October; only 3 reservable sites take a 23-ft rig (35 ft). Not waterfront confirmed. Note rewritten.
flags: Rig length: recreation.gov's catalog lists 17 reservable sites; only 005 (44.26058,-71.50343), 011 (44.26117,-71.50379) and 016 (44.26107,-71.50494) permit an RV or trailer of 23 ft+ (35 ft each). 024 takes 20 ft, and the 13 tent-only sites take none. The 12 first-come sites are not in the catalog. Keep: 3 bookable sites fit, and the lengths vary, so they are not a placeholder.

Waterfront not waterfront confirmed: recreation.gov's prose says the campground 'sits along the banks of the Zealand River', but Esri imagery shows the rocky ~10-15 m Zealand channel about 150 m west of the nearest RV site (016) through continuous forest. Even at the river it would be a creek under 30 m.

Phone 603-536-6100 (the WMNF Supervisor's Office, from the FS page footer) is kept. recreation.gov gives (802) 289-0970 for facility-specific information and the concessionaire email whitemountaincampgrounds@goexplorus.com. Optional change: 603-536-6100 -> 802-289-0970 (concessionaire).
